body:
## What does this PR do?

Windows gateway launchers now start Python in UTF-8 mode, so text-mode subprocess readers do not select a GBK locale codec for UTF-8 child output. The shared launcher environment was missing `PYTHONUTF8=1`, and the post-update hidden gateway restart rebuilt a second overlay with the same omission. Generated CMD/VBS launchers, detached gateway starts, and windowless update restarts now agree on UTF-8 mode.

## Related Issue

Fixes #127633

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)

## Changes Made

- `hermes_cli/gateway_windows.py` — adds `PYTHONUTF8=1` to generated launcher environments and the hidden restart overlay.
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_windows.py` — verifies generated VBS and detached gateway launch specifications export UTF-8 mode.
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_update_gateway_launcher_refresh.py` — verifies a post-update restart overlay preserves UTF-8 mode.

## How to Test

- [x] `scripts/run_tests.sh tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_windows.py tests/hermes_cli/test_update_gateway_launcher_refresh.py -q` — 25 passed, 7 Windows-only tests skipped on macOS.
- [x] `ruff check hermes_cli/gateway_windows.py tests/hermes_cli/test_gateway_windows.py tests/hermes_cli/test_update_gateway_launcher_refresh.py` — passed.

## Evidence

- BEFORE RED: the generated VBS launcher test failed because `PYTHONUTF8` was absent from its environment.
- AFTER GREEN: the focused Python command passed 25 tests; broker-bound verification also recorded 25 passed at commit `a623815416e870bac7dc4ed014f890ca7e0e9891`.
- CONTROL: existing launcher arguments, virtual-environment selection, hidden-console behavior, and Python path construction remain covered by the same focused suite.

## Review follow-up

The focused Windows-marked assertions are skipped on the macOS host and will run in the Windows Python CI lane. The classifier also selects the update E2E lane through the gateway update pipeline; its CI gate is not rerun locally.
